mapper.select: /* Attd07Mapper.selectMonthlyAttdReq */ SELECT A.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , A.REQ_ID AS reqId , A.SITE_CD AS siteCd , A.NODE_CD AS nodeCd , A.USER_CD AS userCd , A.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , A.REQ_TYPE , 'SYS032' ) AS reqTypeNm , A.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH( A.CMPNY_CD , 'SYST_VAL' , A.REQ_STATUS , 'SYS033' ) AS reqStatusNm , A.WORK_SEQ AS workSeq , A.WORK_YMD AS workYmd , A.CHECK_IN_DATE AS checkInDate , A.CHECK_IN_TIME AS checkInTime , A.CHECK_OUT_DATE AS checkOutDate , A.CHECK_OUT_TIME AS checkOutTime , A.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , A.INSERT_DATE AS insertDate FROM TB_USER_ATTD_REQ A WHERE A.CMPNY_CD = #{gvCmpnyCd} AND A.SITE_CD = #{siteCd} AND A.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND A.WORK_YMD = #{workYmd} AND A.REQ_STATUS = '01'
